payload.stories:
INHERITS S1-S6 from the first pass, with S1 CORRECTED and THREE ADDED. Killers marked.

S1 (KILLER, Prop 1 / N1, N2, N5) - THE AGENT CONSULTS WHAT THE PROCESS DEMANDS. CORRECTED at slide 3, which the first pass satisfied by redefinition. It now reads: 'it searches v1's method files by ref and gets the matches WITH the surrounding lines it asked for, in one call' - not 'gets hits' and then a second call for context. The slide names what R3 requires so no design can pass it by moving context elsewhere.

S2 (KILLER, Prop 2 / N6, N9) - A GATE JUDGES ITSELF WHERE IT CAN. Inherited, slide 2 already narrowed at M5 to what is lintable today.

S3, S4, S5, S6 - inherited unchanged (a law minted today binds a session tomorrow; a mechanical change is one call; the record survives carelessness; a check that cannot decide does not stop the night).

S7 (KILLER, Prop 2 / N10) - THE GATE THAT WILL NOT LET YOU PASS WITHOUT LOOKING.
Slide 1: an agent finishes a milestone and reaches a gate.
Slide 2: the form asks for the gate's own acceptance items - and then for four more it cannot leave blank.
Slide 3: VERIFY sends it back to each input state to open what the evidence points at, rather than trusting the evidence's description of itself.
Slide 4: VALIDATE sends it to the REQUIREMENT REGISTER, and it finds a requirement no acceptance item covers.
Slide 5: RED-TEAM makes it name what would have to be true for its own conclusion to be wrong, and then go look.
Slide 6: the verdict is REOPEN. It names the states.
WHY KILLER: this is the story whose absence produced every other failure this iteration found. If it does not run, the rest is tooling.

S8 (Prop 2 / N11) - THE REOPEN THAT DOES SOMETHING.
Slide 1: a verdict names states to reopen.
Slide 2: those states and everything derived from them come back to life.
Slide 3: the first pass's fills are marked SUPERSEDED - still on disk, still in the history, no longer counting as done.
Slide 4: a reader months later can see what was claimed the first time, that it was reviewed, and that it did not survive.

S9 (Prop 1 / N2) - CONTEXT ARRIVES WITH THE MATCH.
Slide 1: the agent needs to know what a rule says, not merely where it lives.
Slide 2: it searches with a context window.
Slide 3: the result carries the matched line AND the lines around it, typed, in ONE call.
Slide 4: it reads the ruling without a second round trip - which is the difference between one call and the four this iteration measured.
WHY IT EXISTS AS ITS OWN STORY: R3 was violated precisely because context was treated as a detail of S1 rather than as a thing anyone had to demonstrate. Giving it a story of its own makes it visible at validation.
